# United States Courts

> The official portal for the federal judiciary system, providing comprehensive information on court structure, operations, procedures, and the role of federal courts in the American constitutional system.

United States Courts serves as the central information hub for all federal courts, including the Supreme Court, Courts of Appeals, District Courts, and Bankruptcy Courts. The site offers educational resources, procedural guidance, and structural information about the judicial branch.

## Key Topics

- Federal Courts
- U.S. Supreme Court
- U.S. Courts of Appeals
- U.S. District Courts
- U.S. Bankruptcy Courts
- Article III Judges
- Judicial System
- Court Structure
- Appeals Process
- Bankruptcy Cases
- Civil Cases
- Criminal Cases
- Court Jurisdiction
- Judicial Branch
- Constitutional Authority

## Federal Court System Overview

- [United States Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov): Main homepage for U.S. federal courts system with judiciary overview.
- [About Federal Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts): Overview of federal court role, structure, and constitutional basis.
- [Court Role and Structure](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure): Explanation of federal court structure and constitutional checks and balances.
- [Comparing Federal & State Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/comparing-federal-state-courts): Educational comparison of federal and state court systems.

## Court Types and Structure

- [About the U.S. Courts of Appeals](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-courts-appeals): Overview of appellate court structure and function.
- [About U.S. District Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-district-courts): Overview of district court jurisdiction and organization.
- [About U.S. Bankruptcy Courts](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/about-us-bankruptcy-courts): Overview of bankruptcy court structure and procedures.
- [Court Website Links](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/court-website-links): Directory of links to Supreme Court, Appeals, District, and Bankruptcy courts.

## Types of Cases and Procedures

- [Types of Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases): Guide to federal court jurisdiction and types of cases heard.
- [Civil Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/civil-cases): Guide to civil case procedures and lawsuit process in federal court.
- [Criminal Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/criminal-cases): Explanation of criminal case procedures and judicial process.
- [Appeals](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/appeals): Explanation of appeals process and oral argument procedures.
- [Bankruptcy Cases](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-cases/bankruptcy-cases): Overview of bankruptcy case process and court procedures.

## Federal Judges and Judicial System

- [About Federal Judges](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges): Overview of federal judges and judicial system.
- [Types of Federal Judges](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/types-federal-judges): Guide to Article III judges and judicial appointment process.
- [Authorized Judgeships](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/authorized-judgeships): Historical data on authorized judgeships across federal courts.

## Educational Resources

- [Supreme Court Landmarks](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/educational-resources/supreme-court-landmarks): Interactive educational resource on landmark Supreme Court cases.
- [FAQs: Court Information](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/court-role-and-structure/faqs-court-information): Frequently asked questions about federal court structure and circuits.

## Optional Reference Materials

- [Judicial Compensation](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/judicial-compensation): Historical salary data for federal judges and justices.
- [Judicial Milestones](https://www.uscourts.gov/about-federal-courts/about-federal-judges/judicial-milestones): Records of federal judges' career milestones and appointments.
